correctness.rationale: The CIR generator on Y=X^2 gives two exact stationary moment equations. Regeneration gives the unique invariant law and finite moments for all admissible reset laws. Direct symbolic expansion of m2-m1^2 confirms the completed-square identity with strictly positive quadratic and dispersion coefficients; the constraints E[R^2]>0 and Var(R^2)>=0 prove all global optimality/boundary cases. The independent noncentral chi-square sampler verified six parameter/distribution cases and exact variance penalties; sampling is not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The objective is the stationary fluctuation of the natural quadratic confining-energy component. Optimization covers the entire family of independent reset-location distributions, not a hand-picked parameter slice. The exact rate-dependent transition from a unique finite-location optimizer to an excluded-boundary infimum, the universal strict penalty for randomizing reset sites, and the sharp square-root approach provide a complete motivated phase classification beyond reproduction of a known density.
